scenario_name: Vendor Selection Decision Thread — Cloud Infrastructure
description: Decision thread for cloud infrastructure vendor selection. Three vendor proposals evaluated by all three kernels, with orchestrator assembling the decision bundle.

matter.title: Cloud Infrastructure Vendor Selection — 2026
matter.description: Selection of primary cloud infrastructure provider for next 3-year term. Three vendors under evaluation: NimbusTech, CloudPeak Solutions, and SkyGrid Services.

vendor_proposals.proposal_summary: Enterprise cloud platform with global edge network. 3-year commitment at $840K/year with 10% volume discount in years 2-3.
vendor_proposals.contract_flexibility: Annual termination with 6-month notice after Year 1

vendor_proposals.proposal_summary: Hybrid cloud solution with on-premise integration. 3-year fixed price at $720K/year. No volume discount but includes dedicated support team.
vendor_proposals.contract_flexibility: Locked 3-year term, early termination penalty of 50% remaining contract value

vendor_proposals.proposal_summary: Pay-as-you-go cloud with reserved capacity options. Estimated $680K/year based on current usage, but variable. 1-year initial term with auto-renewal.

business_assessment.summary: CloudPeak offers best SLA and dedicated support, critical for operations. NimbusTech provides good balance of cost and capability. SkyGrid is cheapest but variable cost creates budget uncertainty.

risks.description: SkyGrid variable pricing could exceed budget in high-usage months
risks.mitigation: Implement usage monitoring and alerts; negotiate cost caps

risks.description: CloudPeak 3-year lock-in reduces flexibility to adapt to market changes
risks.mitigation: Ensure contract includes technology refresh provisions

recommendations: CloudPeak recommended for operational reliability (99.99% SLA)
NimbusTech as secondary recommendation if contract flexibility is prioritized
SkyGrid not recommended for primary infrastructure due to cost variability
business_assessment.commercial_impact_narrative: Cloud infrastructure is mission-critical. Downtime costs estimated at $15K/hour. The 0.04% SLA difference between CloudPeak (99.99%) and NimbusTech (99.95%) translates to ~3.5 additional hours of potential downtime annually.
stakeholder_impacts: Engineering team prefers NimbusTech API ecosystem

legal_assessment.summary: CloudPeak early termination penalty is aggressive (50% remaining value). NimbusTech termination clause is reasonable. SkyGrid offers most flexibility but weakest SLA enforcement.

risks.description: CloudPeak early termination penalty could cost up to $1.08M if exiting after Year 1
risks.mitigation: Negotiate reduced termination penalty or phased reduction schedule

risks.description: NimbusTech data centers in 4 international jurisdictions — GDPR and cross-border data transfer compliance required
risks.mitigation: Require Standard Contractual Clauses and Data Processing Agreement

recommendations: Negotiate CloudPeak termination penalty down to 25% or add performance-based exit clauses
Require DPA and SCCs from NimbusTech for international data handling
All vendors: ensure indemnification for data breaches with minimum $5M cap
regulatory_implications: GDPR compliance for NimbusTech international data centers
SOC 2 Type II certification required for all vendors

accounting_assessment.summary: SkyGrid has lowest nominal cost but variable structure complicates budgeting and reporting. CloudPeak fixed pricing simplifies financial planning. NimbusTech volume discount structure requires accrual adjustments.

risks.description: SkyGrid variable costs could create 15-25% quarterly budget variance
risks.mitigation: Establish usage reserves; monthly variance reporting

recommendations: CloudPeak preferred for budget predictability and simplified accrual treatment
NimbusTech volume discount requires deferred expense recognition in Year 1
SkyGrid: establish $100K quarterly contingency reserve for usage spikes
tax_implications: Cloud services payments deductible as operating expense
NimbusTech prepayment option could create timing difference for tax purposes
reporting_period_impact: Multi-year commitment requires ASC 842 lease assessment for all three proposals
accounting_assessment.classification_guidance: Operating expense classification appropriate for all three proposals under current accounting standards

decision_bundle.combined_recommendation: CloudPeak Solutions recommended as primary vendor. While not the lowest cost option, it offers the best combination of SLA reliability (99.99%), budget predictability (fixed pricing), and dedicated support. Key negotiation priorities: (1) reduce early termination penalty to 25%, (2) add performance-based exit clauses, (3) include technology refresh provisions. NimbusTech recommended as fallback if termination flexibility is non-negotiable.

follow_up_actions.title: Negotiate CloudPeak termination penalty
follow_up_actions.description: Reduce from 50% to 25% of remaining contract value with performance-based exit clauses

follow_up_actions.title: ASC 842 lease assessment
follow_up_actions.description: Evaluate whether CloudPeak 3-year commitment triggers right-of-use asset recognition

follow_up_actions.title: Migration planning
follow_up_actions.description: Develop migration timeline and resource plan for CloudPeak onboarding
